publicLabel: Name-Only Removal From The Public Index
authority: Alaska Court System form TF-805 (5/25), Administrative Rule 40(b) or (c)
previousOutcome: BLOCKED_AT_STEP_1_SOURCE_GATE -- the corpus was absent in that container and the refusal was correct
howTheGateReopened: The corpus was recovered in this container with scripts/rcap-corpus/bootstrap-private-corpus.sh, which verified the archive SHA-256 (a26e3ca7...) and the corpus's own 00_GOVERNANCE/CHECKSUMS.sha256 before extracting, and reported 51 jurisdictions / 499 files / 329 PDFs. node scripts/verify-packet-build-environment.mjs --family ak-tf805-set printed PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_READY, 14/14 checks passed. Nothing was acquired; egress to court and agency hosts was neither attempted nor needed, and no mirror, cache or aggregator was used.

orderedSteps.name: Verify source SHA-256 against the corpus index
orderedSteps.detail: The binary at the indexed path hashes to 96306d64eda397e25094f92c3d67a642372b82cba12f97c6666e5500136e8f54 at 93899 bytes, matching the corpus index exactly on both. Verdict PROCEED. The build script re-verifies the same two facts independently before it reads a single rectangle, and stops on drift.

orderedSteps.name: Census fields with real geometry
orderedSteps.detail: 17 AcroForm fields across 2 pages of 612x792, matching the corpus index's declared pageCount and acroFieldCount. Every field carries its widget rectangle, printed label and label basis, region heading, protect category and descriptor matches, all read from this document by this lane.

orderedSteps.name: Field map with every write box measured off the document
orderedSteps.detail: Every write box is the AcroForm widget's own /Rect read from the binary. No box is derived from a label position. Stroked geometry was measured independently with scripts/lib/pdf-stroked-boxes.mjs from the DECODED content stream -- 2 rectangles on page 1, 9 on page 2 -- and used only as corroboration: the printed control box under each radio and checkbox, and the box the form draws around its certificate of service. Nothing new was drawn on the form.
orderedSteps.inheritedComparison: All 17 fields agree with the inherited record; 0 disagree. The inherited numbers were used as a cross-check only.

orderedSteps.name: Record every local filing, fee, venue or delivery variation
orderedSteps.detail: Two questions the predecessor had to leave open are closed from the document: `tf` is TrueFiling, and the five-year re-request window attaches to Administrative Rule 40(c) only, not to 40(b). One correction was made: page 1 carries a full notarial jurat, so the request is sworn before a court clerk, notary or other authorized officer rather than merely signed. Each variation was exercised against the rendered fixtures and read back from the artifact bytes. The filing-fee question remains OPEN -- the form does not answer it -- and is recorded as open rather than guessed.

orderedSteps.name: Product wiring without runtime or commercial authority
orderedSteps.detail: Nothing installed. src/lib/rcap-engine/compiled/** untouched. Three of the five install preconditions are now met; the two that remain are human and this lane cannot satisfy either. Measurement confirmed the proposed_order component has zero write boxes: the ORDER block draws four checkboxes and carries no AcroForm widget at all.

orderedSteps.name: Render canonical and boundary fixtures from the source binary
orderedSteps.detail: Rendered fresh from the pinned source bytes through finalizeOfficialForm. Canonical wrote 6 fields and refused 11; boundary wrote 5 and refused 12, the difference being the 88-character boundary email correctly refused as unfittable rather than clipped. Both output hashes were checked against data/rcap-grade-a/stale-artifact-block.json and match none of them. No blocked hash is cited as evidence for anything.

orderedSteps.name: Verify from the artifact bytes
orderedSteps.detail: Every assertion is read back from the flattened appearance streams at each field's own measured rectangle, not from the render report. Refused fields must be empty on the paper and written fields must be present; all eight fields inside the measured certificate-of-service box must be blank; every drawn participant-name token must sit in a blank this family listed. Zero blocking findings across both fixtures.

orderedSteps.name: Raster every page and record a visual review
orderedSteps.detail: All 4 pages (2 pages x 2 fixtures) rastered at scale 1.6 and looked at as images. No clipped value, no value on a wrong printed line, no ink in any signature, verification, notarial jurat, certificate-of-service or court-only rule. The reviewer was the same agent that rendered the pages, so f_independent_visual_review_required is NOT discharged and the record says so.

hardRulesObserved: No participant name was written into any charge, offence, count, statute or violation caption. TF-805 has no such blank on either page -- measured -- so the defect class cannot arise here, and reports/charge-caption-proof.json records that the set is empty by the document's construction rather than by a refusal that happened to hold.

No participant signature was prefilled. The Verification signature rule has no AcroForm field at all, and signature0 in the certificate of service is refused by the shared signature rule and proved blank in both fixtures.

No signature date and no certificate of mailing was prefilled. All eight certificate-of-service fields -- date, time, four method boxes, recipients and signature -- are blank in both fixtures, proved against the certificate box measured off the document.
No court-only or clerk-only field was written. The ORDER block has no AcroForm widget to write into, and the whole of page 2 is blank of participant ink in both fixtures.
No new box was drawn on the form. Every mark would have gone inside a measured widget rectangle, and in the event no checkbox or radio is marked at all.

No verifier was skipped, weakened or quarantined. One family verifier was added and it fails closed; the shared binder was neither modified nor bypassed, and two fields (certDate, signature0) were deliberately left to the shared rules so the shared channel stays observable.
No source binary was committed. private/ is git-ignored and tracks nothing.

Nothing outside the owned path was modified except scripts/build-census-v1-ak-tf805-set.mjs, which is named for this family. No other family's path, no shared manifest, no Production configuration, no legal eligibility record, no route identity, no payment or sponsorship code was touched.
No egress to a court or agency host was attempted. The source was already held.

findings.note: Four observations are recorded in build-findings.json. Three concern shared code outside this family's owned path and are reported rather than edited; one concerns how a caption blank on this form is resolved.

whatFinishingThisFamilyDoesNotDo: It creates no fulfilment record and consumes no packet credit.
It marks no packet proven and approves nothing for participant delivery.
It does not add this track to compiled runtime.
Commercial authority comes from a Grade-A fulfilment record keyed to an exact route and packet family, and from nothing else. This is not that record.
whatIsStillOutstanding: A human independent visual review of the four rastered pages.
Output-level legal approval, requested in approval-request.json and grantable only by a reviewer with that authority.
The Alaska filing-fee question for an Administrative Rule 40(b)/(c) request, which the form does not answer and which must not be presented to a participant as fee-free.
